field_writer_scan.method: python tools/bsp.py scan-bytes over .text for every store-shaped opcode family (F3 0F 11 /r, D9 /2 and D9 /3, 89 /r, C7 /0, 88 /r, C6 /0, FF /0 and /1, 01 /r, 29 /r, 83 /0, F2 0F 11 /r, 0F 29 /r, 0F 11 /r) at the disp32 forms of 3C8h, 3CCh, 3D4h, 3D8h and 604h, then again at 204h, 208h, 20Ch, 210h, 214h and 440h for the blk+1C4h sub-object base that 009DFCB0 uses. local/blk_field_scan.txt holds the raw output.
field_writer_scan.scope_limit: A disp32 scan cannot see a store through a base that is neither blk nor blk+1C4h (a LEA to blk+3C0h and a disp8 store, say), nor a bulk memcpy over the block. The two bases enumerated are the only ones any read routine uses.
